def-ip-simple-surface-and-geodesic-xray-:
## Definition

Let $(M,g)$ be a compact, connected, nonempty smooth two-dimensional Riemannian manifold with smooth boundary. For $x\in\partial M$, let $\nu_{\mathrm{out}}(x)$ be the outward unit normal. The boundary is **strictly convex** if
$$
g(\nabla_w\nu_{\mathrm{out}},w)>0
$$
for every $x\in\partial M$ and every nonzero $w\in T_x\partial M$. A **Jacobi field** along a unit-speed geodesic $\gamma$ is a smooth vector field $J$ along $\gamma$ satisfying
$$
D_t^2J+R(J,\dot\gamma)\dot\gamma=0,
$$
where $R(X,Y)Z=\nabla_X\nabla_YZ-\nabla_Y\nabla_XZ-\nabla_{[X,Y]}Z$. The manifold has **no conjugate points** if, on every unit-speed geodesic segment $\gamma:[a,b]\to M$, a Jacobi field with $J(a)=J(b)=0$ must be identically zero. It is **nontrapping** if every maximal unit-speed geodesic starting in $M^\circ$ reaches $\partial M$ in finite forward and backward time. The pair $(M,g)$ is a **simple surface** if its boundary is strictly convex, it has no conjugate points, and it is nontrapping.

The unit tangent bundle is $SM=\{(x,v):x\in M,\ v\in T_xM,\ g_x(v,v)=1\}$. Write $\nu_{\mathrm{in}}=-\nu_{\mathrm{out}}$ and
$$
\partial_+SM=\{(x,v)\in SM:x\in\partial M,\ g_x(v,\nu_{\mathrm{in}})>0\}
$$
for inward-pointing unit boundary vectors. For $(x,v)\in\partial_+SM$, let $\gamma_{x,v}$ be the unit-speed geodesic with $\gamma_{x,v}(0)=x$ and $\dot\gamma_{x,v}(0)=v$, and let $\tau_+(x,v)$ be its first positive exit time from $M$. For $f\in C^\infty(M)$, its scalar **geodesic X-ray transform** is the function on $\partial_+SM$ defined by
$$
I_0f(x,v)=\int_0^{\tau_+(x,v)} f(\gamma_{x,v}(t))\,dt.
$$
The geodesic equation is interpreted up to first boundary exit; local smooth extensions of the metric are used only to solve the coordinate ODE at boundary initial data.
def-ip-tangent-orientation-double-cover:
## Definition

Let $M$ be a smooth two-dimensional manifold with boundary and let $\det T_xM=\Lambda^2T_xM$ be the determinant line of its tangent space. An orientation of $T_xM$ is a positive ray $o_x$ in this line. The **tangent orientation double cover** is the set
$$
\widetilde M=\{(x,o_x):x\in M,\ o_x\text{ is an orientation of }T_xM\},\qquad \pi(x,o_x)=x.
$$
For a boundary chart $\phi:U\to V\subseteq\mathbb H^2$, let $o_\phi(x)$ be the ray obtained by applying $\det(d\phi_x^{-1})$ to the standard positive ray in $\det\mathbb R^2$. Give $\widetilde M$ the smooth boundary-chart structure whose two local sheets over $U$ are $\{(x,o_\phi(x)):x\in U\}$ and $\{(x,-o_\phi(x)):x\in U\}$, each with coordinate map $(x,\pm o_\phi(x))\mapsto\phi(x)$. On an overlap with a second chart $\psi$, the sheet sign changes by $\operatorname{sgn}\det D(\psi\circ\phi^{-1})$; this sign is locally constant, so the sheet transitions are smooth half-space transitions. Thus $\pi$ is the associated two-sheeted smooth covering map, including over the boundary. The involution $\tau(x,o_x)=(x,-o_x)$ exchanges the sheets. The canonical orientation of $\widetilde M$ at $(x,o_x)$ is the ray $(\det d\pi_{(x,o_x)})^{-1}(o_x)$ in $\det T_{(x,o_x)}\widetilde M$.
lem-ip-surface-geodesic-flow-index-form-:
## Statement

Let $(M,g)$ be a compact, connected, nonempty, oriented smooth Riemannian surface with smooth strictly convex boundary, no conjugate points, and nontrapping geodesic flow. Let $SM=\{(x,v):x\in M,\ v\in T_xM,\ g_x(v,v)=1\}$, and let $\varphi_t$ denote its unit-speed geodesic flow up to boundary exit. For $w\in C^\infty(SM)$ define the geodesic vector field by $Xw=\left.\frac{d}{dt}\right|_{0}w(\varphi_t(x,v))$. Define the vertical vector field by $Vw(x,v)=\left.\frac{d}{d\theta}\right|_{0}w(x,\cos\theta\,v+\sin\theta\,v^\perp)$, where $v^\perp$ is the positive $90$-degree rotation of $v$, and put $X^\perp=[X,V]$. The Liouville measure is $d\Sigma=dV_g(x)\,dS_x(v)$, with induced boundary measure $d\Sigma_{\partial}=dS_{\partial M}(x)\,dS_x(v)$; write $\mu(x,v)=g_x(v,\nu_{\mathrm{in}}(x))$ on $\partial_+SM$.

In a positive orthonormal frame $e_1,e_2$, define $K(x)=g(R(e_1,e_2)e_2,e_1)$; this scalar is independent of the frame. For a positive-length unit-speed geodesic $\gamma:[0,L]\to M$ and a smooth normal field $Y$ with $Y(0)=Y(L)=0$, define the index form
$$
\mathcal I_\gamma(Y,Y)=\int_0^L\left(|D_tY|_g^2-g(R(Y,\dot\gamma)\dot\gamma,Y)\right)dt.
$$
Then $d\Sigma$ is preserved by $\varphi_t$, and the commutators are $[X,V]=X^\perp$, $[V,X^\perp]=X$, and $[X,X^\perp]=-KV$. If $a,b\in C^\infty(SM)$ and $ab=0$ on $\partial SM$, then each $Y\in\{X,V,X^\perp\}$ satisfies $\int_{SM}(Ya)b\,d\Sigma=-\int_{SM}a(Yb)\,d\Sigma$. For every $h\in C(SM)$, Santaló's formula is
$$
\int_{SM}h\,d\Sigma=\int_{\partial_+SM}\mu(x,v)\int_0^{\tau_+(x,v)}h(\varphi_t(x,v))\,dt\,d\Sigma_\partial.
$$
The index form is positive definite: $\mathcal I_\gamma(Y,Y)>0$ whenever $Y\not\equiv0$. Finally, if $f\in C_c^\infty(M^\circ)$ and $I_0f=0$, then
$$
u_f(x,v)=\int_0^{\tau_+(x,v)}f(\gamma_{x,v}(t))\,dt
$$
extends to a smooth function compactly supported in $SM^\circ$, satisfies $Xu_f=-f$, and vanishes on $\partial SM$. For smooth $a,b$ with $ab=0$ on $\partial SM$, integration by parts holds for $X$ and $X^\perp$; for $V$, which is tangent to $\partial SM$, it holds for all smooth $a,b$.
lem-ip-orientation-cover-preserves-simpl:
## Statement

Let $(M,g)$ be a compact, connected, nonempty smooth Riemannian surface with smooth boundary, and assume its boundary is strictly convex, it has no conjugate points, and it is nontrapping. Let $\pi:\widetilde M\to M$ be the tangent orientation double cover, give $\widetilde M$ the pullback metric $\widetilde g=\pi^*g$, and let $C$ be any connected component of $\widetilde M$. Then $C$ is a compact, connected, oriented simple Riemannian surface with smooth boundary, and $\pi|_C:C\to M$ is a local isometry mapping $\partial C$ onto $\partial M$. For every $f\in C_c^\infty(M^\circ)$, define $\widetilde f=f\circ\pi$. For each incoming unit vector $\widetilde z\in\partial_+SC$, the scalar geodesic X-ray transform satisfies
$$
I_{0,C}\widetilde f(\widetilde z)=I_{0,M}f(\pi(\widetilde z)).
$$
In particular, zero data for $f$ on $M$ gives zero data for $\widetilde f$ on every component $C$.
lem-ip-pestov-identity-for-geodesic-data:
## Statement

Let $(M,g)$ be a compact, connected, nonempty, oriented smooth Riemannian surface with smooth strictly convex boundary, no conjugate points, and nontrapping geodesic flow. Set $SM=\{(x,v):x\in M,\ g_x(v,v)=1\}$ and let $\varphi_t$ be the unit-speed geodesic flow until boundary exit. For $w\in C^\infty(SM,\mathbb R)$ define $Xw=\left.\frac{d}{dt}\right|_{0}w(\varphi_t(x,v))$. Define $Vw(x,v)=\left.\frac{d}{d\theta}\right|_{0}w(x,\cos\theta\,v+\sin\theta\,v^\perp)$, where $v^\perp$ is the positive $90$-degree rotation of $v$, and set $X^\perp=[X,V]$. For a positive orthonormal frame $e_1,e_2$, let $K(x)=g(R(e_1,e_2)e_2,e_1)$, where $R(A,B)C=\nabla_A\nabla_BC-\nabla_B\nabla_AC-\nabla_{[A,B]}C$; this value is independent of the frame. Let $d\Sigma=dV_g(x)\,dS_x(v)$ be the Liouville measure and define $(a,b)=\int_{SM}ab\,d\Sigma$ and $\|a\|^2=(a,a)$. For every real-valued $u\in C^\infty(SM)$ with $u=0$ on $\partial SM$,
$$
\|VXu\|^2=\|XVu\|^2-(KVu,Vu)+\|Xu\|^2.
$$
